summary:
**r6 source-only verdict: not accepted yet. Three actionable blockers remain.**

1. **Foreign compiler refusal is incomplete.** [finite-cpu-guards.ps1:58](Z:/Projects/OkuFlow/local-work-data/uct-review-implementation-20261023/merge/finite-cpu-guards.ps1:58) misses common compiler processes including `gcc.exe`, `g++.exe`, `clang++.exe`, `c1xx.exe` and `c2.exe`. These can pass preflight. Extend the classifier for the workstation’s compiler families while preserving owner-process exclusions.

2. **The cache hash is recorded but never checked.** [finite-cpu-child.ps1:54](Z:/Projects/OkuFlow/local-work-data/uct-review-implementation-20261023/merge/finite-cpu-child.ps1:54) writes `cacheSha256`; subsequent checks validate selected settings rather than unchanged cache bytes. Retain the post-build cache digest and compare it before the gate, after reacquisition and at completion.

3. **Preflight is outside deadline enforcement.** [finite-cpu.ps1:15](Z:/Projects/OkuFlow/local-work-data/uct-review-implementation-20261023/merge/finite-cpu.ps1:15) performs synchronous hashes, Git and CIM work before reaching the deadline check and monitored-child loop. A blocked preflight can exceed 900 seconds. Put preflight under the watchdog or bound its blocking operations within the same deadline.

All supplied script/original/input hashes match. Fresh AST parsing found no syntax or reserved-variable assignment/binder issues. Tracked named arguments match, and lease release/reacquisition ordering has no observed reentrancy defect.

No scripts, probes, builds or tests were executed; no files were changed. Compute remains **HELD**.
